statement: cconv.c (character-conversion helpers) ported function-for-function into gnucobol-rs. All 9/9 functions have a named, ACTIVE Rust counterpart, confirmed by the typed gnucobol-rs-port-index (9/9 active, 0 doc-only, 0 missing) and the authoritative doxygen parse. Not clean-room: an openly-licensed, provenance-documented, oracle-verified Rust port.

coverage.inventory_confirmed_by: gnucobol-rs-port-index (typed: cconv.c 9/9 active, 0 doc-only, 0 missing) + doxygen preprocessed C parse (DOXYGEN-PARITY.md cconv.c 9/9)

differential_verification.note: All against the EXACT oracle object cconv.o extracted from the static libcob.a (the cconv functions are internal/hidden in libcob.so); cob_runtime_error stubbed. FAIL=0.
differential_verification.scenario_coverage: the full 256-byte cob_toupper/cob_tolower fold; a cob_field_to_string grid (NONE/LOWER/UPPER/LOWER_LOCALE/UPPER_LOCALE folds, rtrim, all-blank, trailing-NUL, single char, error codes); cob_load_collation over all five shipped .ttbl tables (both ebcdic_to_ascii and ascii_to_ebcdic halves). cob_convert_hex_digit/byte + cob_skip_blanks are exercised transitively by the collation parse.
differential_verification.self_contained: 4 in-crate unit tests cover the same surface without the oracle.

non_claims: CCM_LOWER_LOCALE / CCM_UPPER_LOCALE use the C-library locale fold; matched under the pinned LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 (ASCII-only, bytes >= 128 unchanged); other locales not modelled.
cob_load_collation does real filesystem + $COB_CONFIG_DIR I/O (faithful to libcob); the cconv module is therefore not part of the pure-decimal kernel (GNURUST.PUREDEC.0).
cob_runtime_error diagnostic text is not modelled (errors surface as the negative return codes).

license_boundary.statement: Faithful DERIVATIVE PORT of GPL GnuCOBOL 3.2 cconv.c, NOT clean-room. LGPL-3.0-or-later; the Apache-2.0 KOBOLD layer never mixes (gpl-license-guard-receipt.json).
